findings.reason: The procedure applies standard amplification to the enlarged pair (A′, Π′), which requires S′0 reflecting about the all-zero enlarged input and S′good for Π′. Its input model does not supply or construct S′0; the original S0 acts only on the data space, and controlled access to S0 is separately granted rather than inferred. C_good can implement S′good by compute–phase–uncompute, but that adds 2m C_good calls unless S′good is supplied separately. The smallest unresolved prerequisite is direct access to S′0 or an explicitly supplied controlled-S0 construction. Adding this capability changes the stated input interface, so owner reconciliation is needed.
